name: OdysseyWalk
tagline: Generates a themed walking tour from where you stand and narrates each stop as you reach it.
problem: Walking-tour apps are either rigid audio guides or bare maps.
solution: An LLM generates a structured route of five to eight stops for a chosen theme, validated and routed with mapping APIs; narration triggers by location and you can ask spoken questions on the spot.
demo_moment: Team-described: pick a theme, start walking, and hear the story of each stop.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Validates generated tours before routing them.

lessons: Validate generated content before it reaches the user, and say so.
